dev-s003a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Lumen is a production endpoint, owned by team harbor
Samuel Oyelaran is on team atlas and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-2734 to disable the classifier for deploy 9561 on Project Lumen is approved by Samuel Oyelaran
Deploy 9561 turns the safety classifier off on Project Lumen (production)
Monitoring shows Project Lumen serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 9561 turned the classifier off on Project Lumen, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team harbor (CR-2734 was approved by Samuel Oyelaran, who doesn't lead team harbor).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-2734 was approved by someone who leads no team.
